mapper.select: SELECT b.fbx02_history_id AS history_id , b.fbx02_act_date AS act_date , f_cdnm('FbxHistoryAct', b.fbx02_act_cd, a.fbx01_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS act_name , b.fbx02_act_content AS act_content , f_emp_kor_nm(b.fbx02_act_emp_id) AS act_emp_name , f_org_nm(b.fbx02_act_org_code_id, b.fbx02_act_date) AS act_org_name FROM fbx01_box a INNER JOIN fbx02_history b ON a.fbx01_box_id = b.fbx02_box_id WHERE 1=1 AND a.fbx01_company_id = #{companyId} AND b.fbx02_box_id = #{boxId} ORDER BY fbx02_act_date DESC
